claims.text: Role in tetanus: benzos = the standard of care for rigidity and spasms;
claims.quote: Benzodiazepines are the standard of care to control rigidity and spasms.

claims.text: diazepam helps control seizures, rigidity and sedation; dosing needs meticulous titration and close observation;
claims.quote: Diazepam can help control seizures, counter muscle rigidity, and induce sedation. Dosage varies and requires meticulous titration and close observation.

claims.text: midazolam (water soluble) is preferred for prolonged tx: ↓ lactic acidosis from the propylene glycol solvent in diazepam and lorazepam;
claims.quote: Diazepam has been used most extensively, but midazolam is water soluble and preferred for prolonged therapy. Midazolam reduces risk of lactic acidosis due to propylene glycol solvent, which is required for diazepam and lorazepam

claims.text: benzos may not prevent reflex spasms: paralytics and mechanical ventilation may be needed.
claims.quote: Benzodiazepines may not prevent reflex spasms, and effective respiration may require neuromuscular blockade with vecuronium or other paralytic medications and mechanical ventilation.

claims.text: Inj CI: acute narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnea syndrome;
claims.quote: in patients with acute narrow-angle glaucoma, or in patients with sleep apnea syndrome

It is also contraindicated in patients with severe respiratory insufficiency, except in those patients requiring relief of anxiety and/or diminished recall of events while being mechanically ventilated.
The use of ATIVAN Injection intra-arterially is contraindicated because, as with other injectable benzodiazepines, inadvertent intra-arterial injection may produce arteriospasm resulting in gangrene

claims.text: Boxed warning: w opioids, profound sedation, resp depression, coma and death.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of benzodiazepines and opioids may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

claims.text: Antidote flumazenil: use = controversial (toxicity if indications, administration and monitoring aren't appropriate; toxicologist consult recommended);
claims.quote: * Use is controversial because toxicity may result if indications, administration, and monitoring are not appropriate. Consultation with a medical toxicologist is recommended.
claims.locator: Specific antidotes: table Common Specific Antidotes (Benzodiazepines: Flumazenil*)

claims.text: it can precipitate life-threatening w.draw (eg, seizures).
claims.quote: administration of flumazenil (a benzodiazepine antagonist) may precipitate acute withdrawal reactions, which can be life-threatening (e.g., seizures)
